style_definition.primary_identity: Highly detailed, nostalgic storybook illustration combining delicate hand-inked contours, finely textured watercolor and gouache coloring, warm domestic atmosphere, and richly illustrated vintage objects. Naturalistic subjects are rendered with gentle expressive stylization and tactile surface detail.
style_definition.aesthetic: Cozy, nostalgic, intricate, whimsical, handcrafted, intimate
style_definition.adaptability: Applicable to animals, people, creatures, objects, interiors, architecture, landscapes, and narrative scenes.

rendering.technique: Fine ink drawing combined with layered translucent watercolor, opaque gouache accents, and controlled stippled texture
rendering.detail_resolution: High but selective, emphasizing expressive forms and tactile materials over source complexity
rendering.source_translation: Reillustrate the source in traditional storybook language rather than applying vintage textures to existing rendering
rendering.edge_treatment: Precise but organically irregular contours, softened by fine painterly and ink textures
rendering.dimensionality: Convincing illustrated volume without photographic rendering

composition.structure: Narrative illustration with a clearly readable main subject integrated into a richly furnished environment
composition.hierarchy: Primary subject first, important interacting objects second, decorative environment third
composition.subject_scale: Medium to large, dominating the central portion of the composition
composition.camera: Close to the subject, slightly above or near eye level; preserve the source's essential viewpoint while reducing dramatic foreshortening and overly cinematic perspective
composition.complexity_adaptation: Simplify complex character silhouettes and busy surroundings into distinct illustrated masses without removing identity-defining features
composition.perspective: Naturalistic but gently compressed and simplified
composition.depth: Layered foreground, middle ground, and softly subdued background
composition.balance: Controlled asymmetry with deliberate placement of supporting objects
composition.visual_flow: Curves of objects, furniture, gestures, and decorative motifs guide attention toward the subject
composition.negative_space: Limited but intentionally maintained around focal features
composition.aspect_ratio: Flexible; square and portrait formats particularly suitable

principles.storytelling: Every object should contribute to a believable illustrated moment
principles.readability: Fine details must not compromise recognition of the principal subject
principles.density: Rich decorative detail organized into distinct visual groups
principles.focal_separation: Use contour contrast, brightness, and localized color separation
principles.coherence: All elements share the same hand-painted and hand-inked treatment

framing.default_shape: Full-bleed scene without a decorative border or arch
framing.frame_style: Intimate and immersive rather than poster-like

outer_background.type: None; the illustrated environment fills the entire image

linework.outline_color: Warm charcoal, dark umber, and muted near-black

external_contours.continuity: Mostly continuous, with occasional textured interruptions

internal_contours.density: Adaptive; high on tactile focal materials, reduced on complex garments, hair, and architecture

linework.organic_detail: Hundreds of small directional marks can describe fur, feathers, hair, foliage, and other organic surfaces
linework.material_detail: Precise curved contours and small tonal marks distinguish ceramic, wood, glass, fabric, and metal

color_system.identity: Muted, sophisticated historical palette balancing cool blue-green environments against warm cream, amber, and reddish-brown accents
color_system.contrast: Moderate global contrast with stronger localized contrast at the subject
color_system.temperature: Warm foreground illumination balanced by cool shadowed surroundings
color_system.harmony: Analogous earth tones combined with complementary dusty blue accents
color_system.color_application: Multiple translucent pigment layers, delicately modulated local colors, and selective opaque highlights
color_system.palette_rule: Use the palette as a tonal reference, not as a mandatory fixed color scheme. Adapt local hues to the subject while preserving muted warmth, cool shadow balance, and antique pigment character.
color_system.highlight_policy: Reserve brightest cream and amber colors for important surfaces and visual focal points
color_system.background_policy: Keep background colors slightly darker, cooler, and less saturated than foreground elements

lighting.type: Soft atmospheric interior or natural light with gentle warm highlights
lighting.direction: Compositionally motivated side or upper-side illumination
lighting.temperature: Warm amber highlights and cooler blue-gray ambient shadows
lighting.highlight_style: Small controlled highlights on reflective surfaces and soft broad highlights on organic forms
lighting.practical_lights: Decorative lamps, windows, candles, or other believable sources when appropriate

shading.method: Layered watercolor washes reinforced with fine ink hatching and opaque gouache accents
shading.ambient_occlusion: Moderate at contact points and overlapping surfaces
shading.color_variation: Fine warm-cool pigment variations within individual objects
shading.material_definition: Combination of tonal washes, fine ink marks, and selective highlights
shading.priority: Preserve illustration character over physically accurate rendering

subject_design.overall_style: Naturalistic illustration with gentle whimsical exaggeration
subject_design.anatomy: Credible underlying anatomy with slightly softened, expressive proportions
subject_design.expressions: Subtle, emotionally readable, gentle, and characterful
subject_design.organic_forms: Natural expressive contours; dense directional texture only when supported by the material, such as fur or foliage
subject_design.character_translation: Preserve the characteristic facial proportions and costume identity of stylized sources such as anime, cartoon, or game art, but redraw them using delicate storybook linework and soft traditional pigment modeling
subject_design.clothing_detail_policy: Simplify excessive folds and reflections; preserve major seams, closures, ornamentation, and distinctive silhouettes
subject_design.material_translation: Represent glossy leather and polished metal through restrained ink contours, watercolor shadows, and selective gouache highlights, not continuous digital specular reflections
subject_design.eyes: Expressive but proportionate, with small controlled reflections
subject_design.hands_and_paws: Anatomically coherent with careful articulation and natural object interactions

materials.fur: Dense fine directional strokes with layered gray and warm pigment variation
materials.hair: Individual fine ink strands integrated with broader painted masses
materials.fabric: Soft folds, subtle woven texture, and gentle shadow transitions
materials.ceramics: Warm ivory surfaces with delicate decorative markings and small glossy highlights
materials.wood: Layered brown washes, visible grain, and fine engraved-looking contours
materials.metal: Warm illustrated reflections with restrained specular accents
materials.glass: Subtle transparency and carefully placed highlights
materials.foliage: Detailed leaf silhouettes, precise veins, and layered muted greens

subject_design.subject_integrity: Preserve recognizable anatomy, proportions, distinctive colors, and signature characteristics

botanical_design.style: Vintage botanical illustration with detailed leaf silhouettes, precise veins, and layered muted greens
placement: Botanical arrangements among the decorative objects
Small-scale botanical motifs on ceramics, textiles, and wallpaper

background_design.style: Detailed illustrated environment with vintage decorative character
background_design.depth: Moderate spatial depth with softer, lower-contrast distant regions
background_design.architecture: Naturalistic period-inspired geometry, subtle ornamental woodwork, and textured architectural surfaces
background_design.furniture: Carefully delineated silhouettes with visible material qualities
background_design.decorative_objects: Books, textiles, ceramics, lamps, botanical arrangements, and other contextually appropriate objects
background_design.patterns: Small-scale botanical motifs, lacework, wallpaper, decorative fabric, and engraved ornament when relevant
background_design.windows: Softly painted exterior light and restrained geometric framing
background_design.density: High detail density without uniform visual emphasis. Always keep a furnished cozy environment. When the subject is visually intricate, render the background objects with softer, broader marks, but do not remove them
background_design.sparse_source_background: If the source background is plain, empty, or minimal, build a cozy furnished interior around the subject with contextually appropriate objects such as books, lamps, ceramics, textiles, and plants
background_design.relationship_to_subject: Environment reinforces the narrative while maintaining clear separation from the focal subject

ornamental_language.identity: Domestic, botanical, historical, and handcrafted ornament rather than abstract graphic decoration
ornamental_language.scale: Mostly small and medium motifs integrated into physical objects
ornamental_language.density: High in selected secondary areas, restrained near focal features
ornamental_language.integration: Ornaments belong naturally to depicted objects and environments
ornamental_language.repetition: Subtle repeated patterns establish visual cohesion

texture.character: Subtle printed-paper grain, finely broken pigment edges, irregular transparent washes, and densely articulated pen marks
texture.distribution: Texture follows the physical character and form of each material rather than acting as a uniform noise overlay. Concentrate fine material texture in selected focal surfaces and keep calm broad pigment regions elsewhere.

mandatory_features: Muted warm and cool pigment harmony

source_adaptation.principle: Preserve semantic identity, not source rendering complexity.
source_adaptation.subject_independence: Apply the same target illustration language to anime characters, realistic people, animals, objects, and environments.

detail_budget.primary_subject: Preserve recognizable features, pose, silhouette, expression, and signature accessories.
detail_budget.secondary_details: Simplify, merge, or selectively omit details that do not contribute to recognition.
detail_budget.background: Always keep a furnished storybook environment. Simplify how background objects are drawn according to foreground density, but do not remove the environment. If the source background is plain or sparse, add a cozy furnished interior with contextually appropriate objects.
detail_budget.ornament: Place decorative objects in groups in the available space rather than spreading decoration uniformly.

complex_source_handling: Identify major visual masses before rendering fine detail.
Consolidate repeated lines and tiny tonal transitions.
Translate source materials into the target illustration technique.
Maintain strong separation between subject, clothing layers, and background.
Avoid retaining source-specific cinematic lighting, digital gloss, or microtexture unless essential to subject identity.
Do not alter the character's recognizable anatomy, outfit design, pose, or distinctive accessories merely to simplify rendering.
source_adaptation.complexity_rule: The more visually complicated the input, the stronger the structural simplification. Do not increase the target style's overall detail density to match the input.

generation_instructions.style_prompt: Create a richly detailed vintage storybook illustration rendered in fine traditional pen-and-ink linework, layered watercolor washes, and subtle opaque gouache accents. Use extraordinarily delicate directional strokes, stippling, and selective hatching to describe organic textures and material surfaces. Render subjects with believable anatomy, softly rounded volume, natural expressive gestures, and restrained whimsical stylization. Apply a sophisticated muted palette with warm ivory, amber, sienna, and umber balanced against dusty blue, slate teal, and cool charcoal. Establish soft atmospheric illumination and gently textured shadows. Surround the central subject with a believable, carefully furnished illustrative environment containing contextually appropriate decorative details. Maintain finely controlled visual hierarchy, clear silhouettes, richly differentiated materials, and tactile paper texture. The overall result must resemble a meticulously handcrafted, traditionally printed European storybook illustration rather than a modern digital painting, cartoon, photograph, or 3D render. If the source background is plain or sparse, build a cozy furnished interior around the subject with books, lamps, ceramics, textiles, and plants. Only for anime, fantasy, or highly rendered digital sources: keep the subject's identity, and simplify cinematic perspective, glossy highlights, and repetitive garment details into traditional pen-and-ink, watercolor, and gouache techniques.
generation_instructions.negative_prompt: photorealism, CGI, 3D, smooth vector graphics, flat cartoon coloring, glossy anime rendering, cel shading, thick outlines, plastic surfaces, neon saturation, cinematic bokeh, harsh HDR, extreme chiaroscuro, airbrushed gradients, blurry facial details, simplified textures, chaotic composition, generic watercolor filter, oversaturated colors, random decorative symbols, excessive grunge, warped anatomy, distorted objects, text, watermark
priority_order: Preserve semantic identity, not source rendering complexity
Preserve clear silhouettes and focal hierarchy
Avoid modern digital or photographic appearance

reference_image_usage.style_references: Use the reference image as authority for line density, pigment texture, color harmony, lighting softness, material rendering, and nostalgic illustration character.
reference_image_usage.subject_reference: Preserve the identity, appearance, and essential characteristics of the supplied subject without copying unrelated objects from the style reference.
reference_image_usage.texture_transfer: Strong transfer of illustrated texture, not literal copying of object-specific patterns
